RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT

This Residential Lease Agreement is entered into as of March 15, 2026, by and between Sarah Mitchell (hereinafter referred to as "Tenant") and David Chen (hereinafter referred to as "Landlord").

RECITALS

WHEREAS, Landlord is the owner of certain real property located at 142 Oak St, Sacramento, CA 95814; and

WHEREAS, Tenant desires to lease the Property for residential purposes;

NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants contained herein, the parties agree as follows:

1. TERM. The lease term shall commence on April 1, 2026 and shall terminate on March 31, 2027.

2. RENT. Tenant agrees to pay monthly rent in the amount of $4,200/month, due on the first day of each calendar month.

3. SECURITY DEPOSIT. Tenant has deposited with Landlord the sum of $8,400 as a security deposit.

4. TENANT INFORMATION. Tenant's Social Security Number is 123-45-6789. Tenant's date of birth is 03/15/1988. Tenant is currently employed by Acme Corp with an annual income of $95,000.

5. OCCUPANTS. The following additional occupants will reside at the Property: Emma, age 7, who is the minor child of Tenant. Emma attends a local school.

6. REASONABLE ACCOMMODATION. Tenant has a documented disability and has requested a reasonable accommodation under applicable fair housing laws. Landlord agrees to provide such accommodation.

7. GOVERNING LAW. This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of California.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the date first written above.

Tenant: Sarah Mitchell
Landlord: David Chen
